content.source_meaning: The historical source proposes a burial field where snow participates in memorial treatment of the dead.
content.normalized_lore: One proposed funerary custom allows seasonal snow to participate in remembrance rather than keeping graves permanently clear.
details: Snow may intentionally alter or obscure grave inscriptions.

legacy_bindings.note: The underlying custom is portable beyond the old placement.

provenance.source_title: Angels So Cold Beneath the Red Sky
provenance.excerpt: A remote field beyond the Abbey might be consecrated as a burial field.
